items.item: A left navigation groups the settings sections
items.evidence: The aside nav lists app pages (Dashboard, Users, Billing, Company settings, Audit log), not the settings sections. General, Localization, Notifications and Danger zone are stacked sections on one scrolling page with no section nav.

items.item: Each section uses one save model consistently (per-section save); autosave is used only for toggles and says so
items.evidence: There is a single global sticky bar (#save 'Save changes' / #discard) for the whole form, not per-section save. Nothing says autosave is used anywhere.

items.item: Localization settings show a formatted preview of a date and an amount
items.evidence: #preview is updated by preview(). It shows the date in the chosen format plus 14:30 and the timezone, and an Intl.NumberFormat currency amount (12480.5 in the chosen currency).

items.item: Every toggle has a visible label and states what it controls
items.evidence: The page has no switch toggles. Notification checkboxes are labelled by a visible row header (th scope=row, e.g. 'Payment failed') and a column header (Email / In-app / Slack), plus an aria-label such as 'Payment failed via Email'. Weak but acceptable.

items.item: The danger zone is separated at the end and its destructive action requires typing the company name or an equally strong confirmation
items.evidence: The red-bordered 'Danger zone' section is last. 'Delete company' opens a modal where #m-ok stays disabled until #m-input equals 'Northwind Logistics GmbH' (mIn.oninput). Transfer ownership requires typing TRANSFER.

items.item: Success is confirmed briefly; errors appear inline next to the field and persist
items.evidence: toast('Company settings saved') auto-hides after 3000ms. #name-err and #email-err sit under their inputs, get aria-invalid and a red border, and stay visible until validate() runs again. Validation only runs on Save or Discard, not on blur.

notes: Audit score 96; its only violation (table-above-fold) is not relevant to a settings page. Restrained layout with no gradients, glass, emoji, KPI tiles or hover-lift. Main failures are structural: the left nav is global app navigation rather than a settings-section nav, and there is one global save bar instead of per-section save. The 'MR' initials avatar is a real person (not a tell). The indigo accent is on a white sidebar, so navy-sidebar-indigo-accent does not apply. The Preview box inside a section card is a minor nested surface, not counted as card-in-card.
